commands.grid: Rulers: Show or Hide the Baseline Grid
commands.columns: Rulers: Show or Hide the Column Overlay

tools.set: Sets the guides, the column overlay per breakpoint, the baseline grid and what is shown in every view, and answers the state. Without arguments it answers the state unchanged.

errors.bad_args: Rulers and guides got a value it cannot use: {reason}

panel.guides_empty: No guides yet. Drag one out of a ruler or add one here.
panel.max_width_hint: Empty: from the template, else the full width.
panel.reset_hint: Drops your own guides and setups; the project's settings apply again.
panel.not_saved: Applied to the open views; not saved, as no project is open.
panel.error_busy: rBrowser is still busy with earlier requests of the rulers. Try again in a moment.
panel.error_timed_out: The rulers took too long and were stopped. Try again; the rBrowser log has the details.
panel.error_no_answer: The rulers did not answer in time. Try again in a moment.
panel.error_suspended: The rulers failed repeatedly and are paused. Resume them in Settings > Plugins.
panel.error_other: The rulers could not apply the change. The rBrowser log has the details.

visible.label: Show the rulers
visible.description: Whether the rulers show in every view when a project opens. Ctrl+Shift+Space O R switches them.
visible.help: Whether the rulers show in every view when a project opens; Ctrl+Shift+Space, O, R switches them any time.

unit.label: Unit of a new vertical guide
unit.description: How a vertical guide dragged out of the ruler counts: px from the left, px from the right, or per cent of the page's width for fluid layouts. Horizontal guides count px from the top.
unit.help: How a vertical guide dragged out of the ruler counts: px from the left, px from the right (px-right) for right-aligned layouts, or percent of the page's width for fluid layouts.

snapPx.label: Snap step (px)
snapPx.description: With Shift held, a dragged guide snaps to a multiple of this many CSS px. 0 switches snapping off.
snapPx.help: With Shift held, a dragged guide snaps to a multiple of this many CSS px. Example: 8 for an 8-px grid. 0 switches snapping off.

guides.label: Shared guides
guides.description: Guides every view shows until someone changes them; set in the project to share them with the team. Your own changes are kept in .rbrowser/out/rulers-guides/ and win.
guides.help: Guides every view shows, set in the project to share them with the team (axis, position, unit). Your own changes are kept in .rbrowser/out/rulers-guides/ and win over them.

columns.label: Column overlay per breakpoint
columns.description: A setup per breakpoint id - columns, gutter, margin, maxWidth, align, or a template (bootstrap, tailwind) - and * for every other breakpoint.
columns.help: A column overlay per breakpoint id: columns, gutter, margin, maxWidth, align, or a template (bootstrap, tailwind); * applies to every other breakpoint. Example: desktop with 12 columns, gutter 24.

lineHeight.label: Baseline grid: line height (px)
lineHeight.description: The distance of the baseline grid's lines in CSS px (2 to 1000).
lineHeight.help: The distance between the baseline grid's lines in CSS px (2 to 1000), usually your body line height. Example: 24.

offset.label: Baseline grid: offset (px)
offset.description: Where the baseline grid's first line lies, in CSS px from the top of the page.
offset.help: Where the baseline grid's first line lies, in CSS px from the top of the page, to align it with the first text line.
